viva.summary: The student successfully implemented the recursive-descent parser but lacks a deep understanding of how the grammar rules translate into the postfix transformation logic. They struggle to trace the execution flow of the while loops, particularly regarding operator precedence and associativity.

rubric.revise_next: Review how recursive-descent parsers handle operator precedence by mapping operators to specific function levels (e.g., term vs. expr).
